roots.origin: 拉丁语 fortis（强壮的、有力的）
roots.core_concept: strong, holding firm / 强壮、撑得住
roots.core_image: 一堵厚墙稳稳立着，外面怎么推都推不动

roots.origin: 拉丁语 fortuna（命运、运气）——本义'所遭遇的'，与 fortis 相关但不直接
roots.core_concept: what chance brings one's way / 命运降落到人头上的那份好坏
roots.core_image: 转盘停下，指针落定的那一刻，决定了好坏

roots.origin: 拉丁语 gravis（重的、沉甸甸的）
roots.core_concept: heavy, weighty / 重、沉甸甸压着
roots.core_image: 一块铅锭沉在手里，分量压得手往下坠

roots.origin: 拉丁语 tempus（时间）→ tempor-；temperare（调和，'按时得当'引申）
roots.core_concept: time; the right measure at the right time / 时间，及按时得当的分寸
roots.core_image: 沙漏里的沙缓缓流下，刻度处正好

roots.origin: 拉丁语 temptare（试探、考验）——注意与 time 无关
roots.core_concept: to test, to probe and try / 试探、考验
roots.core_image: 伸出一根手指轻轻碰一下水面，探它冷不冷
roots.english_definition: to try, to test, to probe

concepts.concept: strong and firm, able to hold up
concepts.core_image: 厚墙立着，怎么推都不动

concepts.concept: what chance brings, one's lot in life

concepts.core_image: 铅锭压在手里，分量往下坠

concepts.concept: time, and the right measure timed aright
to try and test, probing what comes

words.root_logic: com-（加强）+ fort（强）→ 让人重新强起来的那种安稳 → 安慰
words.origin: 拉丁语 confortare（使强壮）：com-（加强）+ fortis（强壮）
words.native_definition: a state of ease and calm; to soothe someone
words.core_concept: the easing that restores strength – 让人重新有力气的安顿
words.core_image: 累了一天后陷进软沙发里，那一下全身放松的感觉
words.recall_hint: com-（加强）+ fort（强）→ 让人重新强壮 → 安慰

words.root_logic: comfort（舒适）+ -able → 能让人安顿下来的 → 舒适的
words.native_definition: giving ease and relaxation; at ease
words.core_concept: able to rest and recover strength – 能让人放松休整的
words.core_image: 那双旧鞋已经穿出脚形，走一天也不磨脚
examples: She felt comfortable in the group.

words.root_logic: ef-（ex- 出）+ fort（强）→ 把力量使出来 → 努力
words.origin: 拉丁语 exfortis：ex-（出）+ fortis（强壮）——'使出气力'
words.native_definition: physical or mental energy used to do something
words.core_concept: strength pushed out toward the task – 朝事情使出去的那股劲
words.core_image: 双手抓住箱子两端往上抬，脸都涨红了的那一下
examples: It took great effort to finish.
She made every effort to help.
words.recall_hint: ef-（出）+ fort（强）→ 使出力 → 努力

words.root_logic: fortun（命运）+ -e → 命运降下的那份好坏 → 运气；财富
words.native_definition: chance as a force in life; a large amount of money
words.core_concept: what fate hands down – 命运递到手上的那份
words.core_image: 抽奖箱里摸出一张券，展开一看中了大奖，那一下就是它
examples: He made a fortune in trade.
semantic_expansions: 财富：命运眷顾带来的钱财
words.recall_hint: fortun（命运）→ 命运递来的 → 运气

words.root_logic: fortune（运气）+ -ate → 有好运气的 → 幸运的
words.native_definition: having good luck or a favorable outcome
words.core_concept: receiving good from fate – 命运给了好的一份
words.core_image: 雨刚停你正好到站，一滴没淋着，运气就是这感觉
examples: She is fortunate to have support.
semantic_expansions: 幸运：命运给了好的一份

words.root_logic: mis-（坏）+ fortune（运气）→ 坏运气 → 不幸
words.core_concept: fate handing down a bad lot – 命运递来的坏一份
words.core_image: 台风过境，家里被水淹了半层，那一片狼藉就是它
examples: The flood was a great misfortune.
semantic_expansions: 不幸：命运递来的坏一份
words.recall_hint: mis-（坏）+ fortune（运气）→ 坏运气

words.root_logic: grav（重）+ -e → 沉重的 → 严重的；坟，埋重的那处
words.origin: 拉丁语 gravis（重）；名词'坟'义来自日耳曼语 gräf（挖），撞音
words.native_definition: serious and worrying; a place of burial
words.core_concept: heavy with weight or worry – 压得人心沉的
words.core_image: 医生的表情一下沉下来，那句诊断还没说出口，气氛已经压住了
words.recall_hint: grav（重）→ 沉甸甸压着 → 严重

words.root_logic: grav（重）+ -ity → 重的性质 → 重力；严肃
words.native_definition: the force that pulls things down; seriousness
words.core_concept: the heaviness that pulls things down – 把东西往下拽的那股重
words.core_image: 抛向空中的球升到最高点，顿一下，被那股力量拽回地面
semantic_expansions: 严肃：压着不轻浮的分量
words.recall_hint: grav（重）+ -ity → 往下的重 → 重力

words.root_logic: ag-（ad- 加强）+ grav（重）+ -ate → 使更重 → 加重
words.origin: 拉丁语 aggravare：ad-（加强）+ gravis（重）
words.native_definition: to make something worse or more serious
words.core_concept: adding more weight to an already heavy load – 往本已沉的上面再压
words.core_image: 伤口没好就去搬重物，原来一点小伤被折腾得更厉害了
words.recall_hint: ag-（加强）+ grav（重）+ -ate → 更重 → 加重

words.root_logic: con-（共同）+ tempor（时间）+ -ary → 同处一个时代的 → 当代的
words.origin: 拉丁语 contemporaneus：com-（共同）+ tempus（时间）
words.native_definition: belonging to the present time; of the same period
words.core_concept: sharing the same time as now – 与当下同处一个时刻
words.core_image: 同一代人的合影里，大家穿的衣服、留的发型都在同一个时代
semantic_expansions: 同时代：与他人同处一时
words.recall_hint: con-（共同）+ tempor（时间）→ 同处一时

words.root_logic: tempor（时间）+ -ary → 只属于一段时间的 → 临时的
words.native_definition: lasting only for a limited time
words.core_concept: bound to a stretch of time, not forever – 只占一段时间、不永久
words.core_image: 工地旁的蓝色铁皮房，住一段就拆，不是长久之计
words.recall_hint: tempor（时间）+ -ary → 只属一段时间的

words.root_logic: temper（调和）→ 按时得当的调配 → 脾气；使缓和
words.origin: 拉丁语 temperare（调和、使适中）——tempus 的'按时得当'引申
words.native_definition: a person's mood or nature; to make something less extreme
words.core_concept: mixing to the right measure at the right time – 按分寸调配
words.core_image: 调酒师把几种酒按比例兑在一起，最后那一下点味
examples: He tempered the criticism with praise.
semantic_expansions: 脾气：那点分寸失当的样子
words.recall_hint: temper（调和）→ 按分寸调配 → 脾气

words.root_logic: tempt（试探）→ 试探一个人的定力 → 引诱
words.native_definition: to attract or lure someone to do something, often wrong
words.core_concept: probing one's resolve – 试探一个人的定力
words.core_image: 橱窗里的甜点摆得诱人，路过时脚就不由自主往那边挪
words.recall_hint: tempt（试探）→ 试探定力 → 引诱

words.root_logic: at-（ad- 朝向）+ tempt（试探）→ 朝目标试一下 → 尝试
words.origin: 拉丁语 attemptare：ad-（朝向）+ temptare（试探）
words.native_definition: to try to do something; an effort to do something
words.core_concept: reaching out to test the way – 伸手朝目标探路
words.core_image: 第一次滑冰，扶着栏杆小心翼翼地迈出第一步，试了试站不站得稳
words.recall_hint: at-（朝向）+ tempt（试探）→ 朝目标试 → 尝试

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ tempt（试探）→ 看穿之后轻慢地对待 → 蔑视
words.origin: 拉丁语 contemptus：com-（完全）+ temptare（试探）——'看透了'
words.native_definition: a strong feeling of disliking and despising
words.core_concept: dismissing after probing and finding nothing worthy – 试探后觉得不屑一顾
words.core_image: 对那种当面一套背后一套的做法，他只斜眼看了下就不再正眼
examples: She looked at him with contempt.
words.recall_hint: con-（完全）+ tempt（试探）→ 看透而不屑 → 蔑视
